scoredBy: dispatcher (Claude Opus 5.5), from the real-viewer screenshots, after all five existed; criteria frozen in CRITERIA.md
defaultWhy: Solo Run Dashboard scores 95/100: it is the only layout where one view per joint answers Zach's question directly — feedforward (blue area) plus feedback (orange area) stacked into the commanded torque, with target grey and applied thin — while its config group's fan sits behind the run's feedback and error, and the 3D and run card stay on screen. Closest alternative: Distribution First (86), better when the question is the whole group rather than one run.
decisionHinge: How often Zach reads one run versus the whole group. Switching runs in Solo Run means opening another .rbl (15 files); if 'see all 14 repeats at once' matters more (move 10 points from C1 to C4), Distribution First overtakes it. The splice that removes the hinge: Distribution First's group fans as the opening tab, Solo Run's stacked FF+FB view as the second tab driven by the worst run, Oscilloscope's single combined torque channel for the rest.

c1: The breakdown is split into four views per joint (cmd, FF, FB, applied) with every run in each; you assemble the split yourself.
c2: Every run is a line; the FB-share bars show the spread of one number, no bands over time.
c3: 3D stage and every torque view share the playhead on one screen; no video in the fixture.
c4: The grid is per component, so N only adds lines; 14 coloured lines per view already crowd.
c5: Runs in run colour in every view, unlike the HTML's fixed component colours.
c6: Blueprint embedded; opens on the torque tab.

g1: q1-torque-tab-grid.rrd opens in stock 0.40.0 with its blueprint (screenshots are that viewer).
g2: N·m on every torque view, degrees for error.

c1: Per joint, one view: blue FF area + orange FB area = commanded (thick run colour), target grey, applied thin; FB share 24 % in the run card.
c2: The run's feedback, commanded and error each sit over its config group's min–max and p25–p75 fan.
c3: 3D (run vs target), run card and all six views on one screen, one playhead at the worst moment.
c4: Structure never changes with N, but switching runs means opening another .rbl (one per run).
c5: Same component colours as the HTML (FF #3b82f6, FB #f97316, target grey, commanded = run colour).
c6: Embedded blueprint opens the worst run; any other run needs its .rbl beside the .rrd.

g1: q2-solo-run.rrd opens in stock 0.40.0 on the worst run; the best-v2 shot is its .rbl.
g3: 3D title and run card say SIMULATED.

c1: Feedback and commanded are separate rows and feedforward is not drawn, so one run's split has to be read across views.
c2: Fans per config group (min–max, p25–p75, median) for error, feedback and commanded; worst run bold on top; individual runs one eye-click away.
c3: 3D, distribution card and all fans share the playhead on one screen.
c4: Grows by config group, not by run: 14 or 140 repeats draw the same.
c5: Group colours (brown v1, blue v2) are new; the HTML has no group colour yet.

c1: Each group tab has the components, but the 'v1 vs v2' tab shows feedback and commanded fans only, without feedforward or applied.
c2: The v1-vs-v2 tab is two fans for error, feedback and commanded; no single run is drawn against them there.
c3: The comparison tab has no 3D; diagnosis means switching tabs.
c4: Tabs grow with config groups, not runs; inside a group tab every run is a line.
c5: Group colours new; a blue commanded line (Real #08) reads as feedforward.
c6: Embedded; opening the .rrd alone was exercised.

c1: CH2 puts target, commanded, FF and FB in one view per joint; legible for the bold worst run, busy with 14 faint runs behind.
c2: Every run faint with the worst bold shows the spread, but no bands.
c3: Oscilloscope stack on one clock: 3D, error, torque, applied, current; zoom exercised.
c4: Structure constant; faint lines grow with N.
